notes.text: We now ensure that table contents are correctly refreshed when an entry needs to no longer be displayed after mass edit
Value help now shows distinct values when the value list is annotated with DistinctValuesSupported
In the Form building block, FormContainer IDs are now correctly anchored to the enclosing fragment prefix when loaded using loadFragment
We've resolved an issue where table variants weren't displayed on a list report page in multi-view mode
You can now use the adaptNavigationTargets controller extension to modify the navigation targets that appear in the popover for semantic object links
We've resolved an issue where the sort arrow wasn't displayed in headers of grid table columns when variantManagement was set to None
